The independently enumerated standalone checker passed 114 finite tests; no numeric test substitutes for proof.

value.rationale: A known controlled field can be toggled in two configurations to learn coupling and an unknown common magnetic offset. The model-specific exact optimization has a sharp parameter threshold and a surprising asymptotic escape from the vanishing determinant suffered by every one-field design. The gain diverges exponentially as the antiferromagnetic coupling strengthens, a natural, experimentally meaningful loss-of-identifiability problem. The statement is stronger than re-evaluating a known fixed-field determinant.
